name: Historic Centre of Camagüey
description: Camagüey is a colonial city in central Cuba, moved to its inland site in 1528 and once a hub of cattle ranching and sugar. Its old centre is a tangle of winding streets, alleys and irregular squares, unlike the tidy grids of most Latin American towns on flat land. Wander past big clay rain jars called tinajones and buildings in styles from neoclassical to Art Deco.
